English.Char_Desc_45: Daily prayer times and Azan alarms
English.Char_Desc_80: Free Windows prayer clock with Azan and custom Jamaat alarms.
English.Char_Desc_250: Azan Clock shows daily prayer times for your city and plays an Azan for each of the five prayers. Set separate Jamaat times and alarms, and keep the app in the Windows system tray.
English.Char_Desc_450: Azan Clock shows daily prayer times for your city and plays an Azan for each of the five prayers. Set separate Jamaat times and alarms, and keep the app in the Windows system tray. Maghrib updates with the daily prayer schedule. The Windows app is free and ad-free.
English.Char_Desc_2000: Azan Clock shows daily prayer times for your city and plays an Azan for each of the five prayers. Set separate Jamaat times and alarms, and keep the app in the Windows system tray. Maghrib updates with the daily prayer schedule. The Windows app is free and ad-free. Save the portable EXE in a permanent folder and open it. Keep Windows awake and signed in for alarms.
